response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind AS tradekind, p.cnt AS trader_count, p.cnt * 1.0 / s.total_cnt AS share_of_total, p.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_average FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND p.cnt > s.avg_cnt ORDER BY p.cnt DESC

assumptions.assumption: Traders with a NULL tradekind form a single group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together) and count as one type in the average and total.
The average is the plain unweighted mean of the per-type distinct-trader counts, computed in floating point so nothing is rounded or truncated.
If no types exist (empty join), the average is NULL and no rows are returned.
